title: Book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- book cover base -->
  <rect x='18' y='24' width='64' height='54' rx='5' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- lighter top edge of cover -->
  <rect x='18' y='24' width='64' height='7' rx='3' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- pages -->
  <rect x='24' y='31' width='52' height='40' rx='2' fill='#fdf3d0'/>
  <!-- page shading on right -->
  <rect x='62' y='31' width='14' height='40' rx='2' fill='#efe0b0'/>
  <!-- spine highlight -->
  <rect x='18' y='24' width='6' height='54' rx='3' fill='#a83226'/>
  <!-- left page lines of text -->
  <rect x='30' y='38' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fb3d5'/>
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fb3d5'/>
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='18' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fb3d5'/>
  <!-- right page lines -->
  <rect x='64' y='38' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9fc8e0'/>
  <rect x='64' y='45' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9fc8e0'/>
  <!-- bookmark ribbon -->
  <path d='M70 24 L78 24 L78 40 L74 35 L70 40 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <!-- gold emblem on cover bottom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='5' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#c0392b'/>
</svg>
